name: source_network_contrast_and_constraint
motivation: The frozen global mammal exploratory analysis indicates both attenuation of C-minus-R3 with external isolation/species breadth and a strong presence-absence asymmetry in the predictive gain. A future independent system must distinguish source-network opportunity from source-network constraint prospectively.

future_primary.required_new_system: independent response-sealed island occurrence system not used in Structural discovery or model development
future_primary.external_isolation_attenuation: predeclared positive association between external isolation and C-minus-R3
future_primary.species_breadth_attenuation: predeclared positive association between occupancy breadth and species-level C-minus-R3

predeclared_behavior_guardrails.presence_cell_C_minus_R3: report prospectively; do not select direction after response
predeclared_behavior_guardrails.absence_cell_C_minus_R3: report prospectively; do not select direction after response
predeclared_behavior_guardrails.class_balanced_block_score: secondary guardrail only, never replaces natural-prevalence primary
predeclared_behavior_guardrails.graph_empty_vs_nonempty: secondary structural-support diagnostic using a response-independent empty-source definition

competing_interpretations.opportunity_signature: C improves realized-presence log loss as well as or more than absence loss
competing_interpretations.constraint_signature: C primarily reduces absence loss / overprediction while presence-cell log loss is unchanged or worse
competing_interpretations.mixed_signature: ranking improves while probability calibration trades off across classes

guardrails: no species or block removal based on outcome
no switch from natural-prevalence primary to class-balanced scoring after response
no causal dispersal/rescue claim from predictive signatures alone
